$schema_note: F0 canonical taxonomy catalog. Data and evidence only — no schema, no routes,
no picker. T1 consumes this file; it does not re-derive it.
READ THIS BEFORE USING THE NUMBERS:
The shortfall is NOT an oversight in this file and must not be closed by
adding plausible rows. See PROVENANCE.md §4 and open question O-F0-1.
tests/v2/taxonomy.check.mjs enforces the contract and therefore FAILS today,
on purpose, naming the exact shortfall.
A  the label, or a normalised equivalent recorded in `source_labels`,
appears on a directly-read marketplace page
B  named in the owner-approved prototype, no external corroboration found
C  proposed only — never canonical, never counted, never seeded
`label` is the canonical Arabic label. `source_labels` preserves the label as
the source actually wrote it, per the F0 rule that a source label and a
canonical label are different things and merging them loses the audit trail.

contract.status: UNMET — 61 of 110 subcategories are named by evidence. Blocked on O-F0-1.

subcategories.label: كلاسيكية
subcategories.note: Canonical label follows the prototype chip «كلاسيكية»; حراج writes «سيارات تراثية». Kept distinct rather than merged — see PROVENANCE.md §3.

subcategories.label: لوحات نقل
subcategories.note: No marketplace read names a transport-plate class. Emirates Auction splits plates by emirate, which is a UAE jurisdiction facet and deliberately not imported.

subcategories.label: مستودعات
subcategories.note: حراج's real-estate branches are rent/sale splits of dwelling types and name no warehouse class; المزاد الحر has only سكني/تجاري/أراضي.

subcategories.label: ذهب
subcategories.note: Emirates Auction has ساعات ومجوهرات but only at category level; المزاد الحر has اكسسوارات - مجوهرات undifferentiated. No source names a gold class.

subcategories.label: ألماس وأحجار كريمة
subcategories.note: WORDING VARIANT: the grid chip reads «ألماس وأحجار», the picker row reads «ألماس وأحجار كريمة». The longer picker form is canonical; the grid form is an abbreviation for chip width. See aliases.

subcategories.label: أقلام وإكسسوارات فاخرة
subcategories.note: WORDING VARIANT: grid «أقلام فاخرة» vs picker «أقلام وإكسسوارات فاخرة». Picker form canonical. See aliases.

subcategories.label: فضة
subcategories.note: PICKER-ONLY. Appears nowhere in the grid; it is the resolution of this category's «+1» placeholder. This single row is the whole proof that a +N placeholder hides a REAL named row somewhere else in the prototype, and the reason the other 11 must be resolved rather than invented.

subcategories.label: أجهزة منزلية
subcategories.note: PARENT AMBIGUITY: three sources file home appliances under an ELECTRONICS parent, the prototype files them under أثاث ومفروشات. The prototype wins because it is the approved product artifact, but browse will surprise a seller who looks for a fridge under إلكترونيات. Flagged as O-F0-3.

subcategories.label: تراثيات
subcategories.note: NEAR MISS, recorded so nobody re-derives it as corroboration: حراج has «تحف وديكور», but under حراج الأثاث, meaning decorative homeware, not heritage collectibles. Different meaning; not counted as a source.

subcategories.label: إبل
subcategories.note: حراج spells it «أبل» without the hamza-under-alif; canonical is «إبل». An orthographic normalisation, not a merge of two meanings.

subcategories.label: أغنام وماعز
subcategories.note: MERGE: both sources keep غنم and ماعز as two separate branches; the prototype merges them into one chip. Following the prototype costs one row. Un-merging would gain one — listed as a candidate for O-F0-1, not applied.

subcategories.label: صقور وطيور
subcategories.note: The BIRD class is corroborated; FALCONS specifically are named by no source read. The prototype's «صقور» is the product's own addition and is plausible for a Saudi auction, but it is prototype authority, not marketplace evidence.

subcategories.label: زراعية
subcategories.note: حراج has a زراعة وحدائق main section but it is leaf-only and exposes no equipment branch.

subcategories.label: معدات ورش
subcategories.note: المزاد الحر has معدات يدوية and معدات المصانع under a شركات parent. Adjacent, not the same class; recorded as near-miss rather than corroboration.

subcategories.label: لوحات
subcategories.note: COLLISION HAZARD: the Arabic word «لوحات» means both a painting and a licence plate, and both meanings are live in this taxonomy (compare plates-vehicle «لوحات سيارات»). Search and any AI category classifier must disambiguate by parent, never by label alone. This is exactly the 'do not silently merge Arabic labels that might have distinct auction meanings' case.

subcategories.label: سجاد يدوي
subcategories.note: NOT corroborated by المزاد الحر's «سجاد - موكيت», which is machine floor covering under المنزل والحديقة. A handmade rug as an art object is a different good. Also near-collides with furniture-rugs-curtains «سجاد وستائر» — same word, two parents, two meanings.

subcategories.label: عبايات
subcategories.note: No source read names an abaya class; both حراج and المزاد الحر stop at ملابس نسائية. A Saudi-market row the prototype adds on its own authority.

subcategories.label: معدات صيد
subcategories.note: حراج has a صيد ورحلات main section, leaf-only, so it corroborates the CATEGORY but supplies no branch.

subcategories.label: دباب ومركبات ترفيهية
subcategories.note: حراج's «دبابات» is motorcycles, mapped to vehicles-motorcycles. It is NOT an ATV and must not be cited here — the same word, two vehicle meanings.

subcategories.label: كل ما لا يندرج تحت قسم
subcategories.note: ARCHITECTURE §5.1 requires misc to keep exactly one general subcategory. That is satisfied and must stay satisfied — misc is not a place to absorb the 49-row shortfall.

$note: EVIDENCE and PROPOSAL are separated on purpose and the separation is the point.
`labels` is what categories.html actually prints — observed, quotable, not negotiable here.
`proposed` is REVERSIBLE validation metadata this file suggests and NOBODY has approved.
T1 must treat `proposed` as a starting draft requiring owner sign-off, not as a decision.
Two hard constraints carried from D-02 §2.1 and CLAUDE.md §4:
- none of these fields is money. المساحة, الممشى, عدد الخانات, الوزن are quantities.
No sar_amount, no money formatter, no second money-shaped column.
- every field is OPTIONAL and never blocks publishing (D-06 §2, prototype note).
DIVERGENCE: D-02 §2's table omits `outdoors` and `misc` and writes fashion as
'(per the prototype's table)'. categories.html supplies all three. The prototype
is used and the divergence is recorded rather than quietly reconciled.

fashion.note: D-02 §2 leaves this row unspecified; categories.html supplies it.

outdoors.note: Absent from D-02 §2 entirely; supplied by categories.html.

misc.note: categories.html: «ما فيه حقول إضافية — الوصف يكفي». Absent from D-02 §2; an empty field set is the decision, not a gap.

display_examples_not_facts.$note: categories.html prints a per-category auction count (1,284 مزاد …). These are PROTOTYPE DISPLAY EXAMPLES. They are recorded here so no future reader mistakes them for measured data and seeds them, and they must never reach a production table.

unresolved.$note: The precise unresolved rows, as F0 requires. NOT filled in. Each anonymous placeholder is a real named row that exists somewhere the prototype does not show — proven by فضة, which was hidden behind «+1» in the grid and only visible in the picker.

beyond_the_placeholders.explanation: 61 named + 11 anonymous = 72, the total the prototype's own grid accounts for. The headline claims 110. Those 38 rows are named by NO artifact in this repository and by NO source read. They are not hidden behind a placeholder; there is no placeholder for them. This is O-F0-1 and it is a product decision, not a research gap.

unresolved.note_on_those_two: حراج's مكتبة وفنون is leaf-only; المزاد الحر has no art or antiques category at all; Emirates Auction stops at بضائع متنوعة. All 8 rows under art and collectibles rest on prototype authority alone. If the owner wants marketplace-sourced art rows, the source set must widen beyond the seven platforms D-02 names — that is a new evidence gate, O-F0-2.

open_questions.question: The count. The prototype's grid accounts for 72 subcategories (60 named + 12 placeholders, one of which the picker resolves to فضة). Its headline, D-02 §1 and the architecture contract all say 110. Which is the contract: 72, 110, or is the fixed count dropped? If 110, who authors the 38 rows that no artifact names, and against what source?
art and collectibles have no subcategory-level corroboration on any of the seven platforms D-02 names. Accept them on prototype authority alone, or widen the source set to art/antique auction houses?

أجهزة منزلية sits under furniture in the prototype and under electronics on حراج، المزاد الحر and سوم. Keep the prototype's parent, or move it? Affects browse and the AI category classifier, not just the picker.

D-02 §1.2 states إنفاذ carries a منقولات متنوعة equivalent. The 2026-08-15 read of infath.gov.sa exposed only عقارات. Is the D-02 claim from a surface not publicly listed, or is it stale? Does not block T1; misc stands on حراج، المزاد الحر and Emirates Auction.
